t: Introduction and overview — Mitsubishi A6M Zero
name: Introduction and overview — Mitsubishi A6M Zero — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Mitsubishi A6M Zero
description: Signature-original re-engineering study: introduction and overview of the Mitsubishi A6M Zero. This is a Signature-original design study, explicitly labeled and never presented as public record. Baseline reference: Single-engine Japanese carrier fighter; 10,939 built by Mitsubishi; dominated 1941-42 Pacific.. The Mitsubishi A6M Zero is a single-engine carrier fighter that dominated the Pacific sky in 1941-42 with unmatched range and agility. Its lightness came at the cost of armor and self-sealing tanks. 10,939 were built; as Allied tactics and aircraft improved, the Zero's advantages faded. Signature improvements explored here: Signature composite primary structures cut empty weight ~12% versus the public baseline; Signature avionics suite with predictive-maintenance health monitoring on every major system.
